card.name: Words introducing cancer-risk study designs
card.fires_on: Words just before a named study or study type in cancer-risk discussions, most often 'prospective' after 'large' or 'meta-analysis of', and also 'a' or 'the' before a named survey or trial.

modes.label: 'prospective' before cohort
modes.description: The word 'prospective' placed before cohort or epidemiology studies when describing cancer-risk evidence.
modes.example: One large meta-analysis of<< prospective>> cohort studies reported increased risks that were dependent

modes.label: Article before named study
modes.description: 'a' or 'the' directly before a named questionnaire, survey or trial in a cancer or hormone-therapy setting.
modes.example: In<< the>> WHIMS estrogen plus progestin anc
